description: This PHP source file defines the ValueValidator class, which implements validation logic for filter values in the SuiteCRM JSON API. It checks if a string contains any banned reserved characters.

classes.name: ValueValidator
classes.description: A validator class that ensures filter values do not contain reserved characters.

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Checks if the input string does not contain any banned reserved characters; throws exception if input is not a string.
